aboutText: With over 15 years of experience in landscape design and construction, Package Landscapes has been proudly transforming outdoor spaces across Kensington and greater Melbourne. We specialise in creating functional, sustainable environments for commercial clients, schools, childcare centres, and local government projects. Our team is known for reliable service, meticulous attention to detail, and a genuine passion for delivering outstanding results every time.
fullWidthImageAlt: Beautiful completed landscape design by Package Landscapes
servicesText: At Package Landscapes, we deliver comprehensive landscape design and construction services throughout Melbourne. From concept to completion, our team creates functional, sustainable outdoor spaces tailored to your specific needs.

services.title: Landscape Design
services.desc: Our commercial landscape design service transforms outdoor areas into stunning, functional spaces that elevate your property and reflect your vision.

services.title: Landscape Construction
services.desc: We handle all aspects of landscape construction with precision and care, delivering high-quality results on time and within budget every time.

services.title: Play Space Design
services.desc: We design engaging, safe, and inclusive play spaces that inspire children's imagination while meeting all Australian safety standards.

services.title: School & Childcare Landscapes
services.desc: Specialised landscaping for early learning centres and school yards, creating stimulating outdoor environments where children thrive and learn.

services.title: Government Projects
services.desc: We partner with local councils and government agencies to deliver large-scale public landscape projects on time and to the highest standards.

services.title: Nature Play
services.desc: Our nature play areas use natural materials and native planting to create immersive outdoor environments that connect kids with the natural world.
